I can suggest popular project-management tools and factors to consider, but the “best” choice depends on your specific team size, workflow, budget, and required features. If you’d like a recommendation, share a bit more context (e.g., team size, Agile vs. waterfall, budget, integrations needed). Otherwise, here are some widely-used options:

• Jira – Robust for software teams, rich issue tracking, deep Agile tooling  
• Asana – User-friendly, flexible workflows, great for marketing/ops teams  
• Trello – Kanban-style boards, highly visual, simple to set up  
• Monday.com – Customizable dashboards, strong automation/rules engine  
• ClickUp – All-in-one (tasks, docs, chat, goals), highly configurable  
• Microsoft Project / Planner – Deep Office 365 integration, enterprise-grade reporting  
• Smartsheet – Spreadsheet-like interface with Gantt charts and resource mgmt

Pick a couple to trial—their free tiers or pilots usually reveal the best fit quickly.

**Jira** is the most widely adopted project-management tool—especially if you’ll be working with software teams or need deep integration with development tools. It offers:

* Kanban and Scrum boards out of the box  
* Custom workflows, issue types, and fields  
* Road-mapping and time tracking  
* 3 000+ marketplace apps (Confluence, Slack, GitHub, etc.)  
* Strong permission and audit controls for larger organizations  

If Jira’s complexity feels heavy, Trello (simpler Kanban) or Asana (balanced feature set) are popular lighter-weight alternatives.

Verizon, T-Mobile, and AT&T are the three major mobile carriers in the U.S. Each has different strengths:

- **Verizon** generally offers the best coverage, especially in rural areas, and tends to have the highest customer satisfaction for network reliability.
- **T-Mobile** usually has the fastest speeds in urban/suburban areas, the best international roaming deals, and often the cheapest unlimited plans.
- **AT&T** strikes a middle ground on coverage and speed, plus it has good perks if you also want fiber internet or HBO Max.
